# Read data (diversity within A.thaliana)
```{r}
# Read data 
# pi 4 fold in 1-1 orthologous genes 
pi_4fold_thal <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_diversity_thaliana/4fol_sites_thal_27g_tair10_based_1to1_genes_pi.txt", header=TRUE, sep='\t') %>% na.omit() %>% distinct()
```

````{r}
## Read centromeres 
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$stop)
# Harmonize chrom naming
centromeres <- centromeres %>% mutate(chromosome = paste0("Chr", chrom))

# Calculate  500 KB widnows, 250 sliding 
calc_window <- function(data, window_size = 500000, step_size = 250000) {
  chromosomes <- unique(data$chromosome)
  results <- list()
  for (chr in chromosomes) {
    chr_data <- data %>% filter(chromosome == chr)
    max_pos  <- max(chr_data$window_pos_2, na.rm = TRUE)
    starts <- seq(1, max_pos, by = step_size)
    for (ws in starts) {
      we <- ws + window_size - 1
      overlap <- chr_data %>% filter(window_pos_1 <= we & window_pos_2 >= ws)
      if (nrow(overlap) == 0) next
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- overlap %>%
        mutate(window_start = ws, window_end = we)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}

average_pi <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      avg_pi_window = sum(count_diffs) / sum(count_comparisons),
      .groups = "drop"
    )}
```
## Calculate pi in sliding windows  
```{r}
pi_4fold_thal <- pi_4fold_thal %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()

write.csv2(pi_4fold_thal, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_diversity_thaliana/4fol_sites_thal_27g_tair10_based_1to1_genes_pi_500mbp_250_sliding_windows.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
## Visualize with dark near centromeres 
```{r}
# Add ancestral centromere, chr1
chr1_rect <- data.frame(
  chromosome = "Chr1",
  xmin = (22243240 - 1000000) / 1e6,
  xmax = (22243240 + 1000000) / 1e6,
  ancestral=TRUE
)

pi_all <- pi_4fold_thal %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = avg_pi_window,
               names_to = "pi_type", values_to = "avg_pi") %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(avg_pi = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop + 250000 &
                           window_end >= centr_start - 250000, NA, avg_pi)) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(med_pi = median(avg_pi, na.rm = TRUE),
         above  = ifelse(avg_pi >= med_pi, avg_pi, med_pi),
         region = case_when(
           window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
           window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_
         )) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(pi_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = avg_pi)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_pi, ymax = above), fill = "#053061", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = pi_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#053061", alpha=0.5) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_pi), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(pi[4-fold])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) + geom_rect(data = chr1_rect,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax),
            ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#57595B", alpha = 0.6) 

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/pi_all_chromosomes.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
# Visualize diversity for A. lyrata 
```{r}
# Read data 
# pi 4 fold
pi_4fold_lyrata <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_diversity_lyrata/4fol_sites_lyr_31g_mn47_based_pi.txt", header=TRUE, sep='\t') %>% na.omit() %>% distinct()
```

````{r}
## Read centromeres 
centromeres <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz_2023.txt",header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$centr_start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$centr_end)

# Calculate  300 KB widnows 
calc_window_not_sliding <- function(data) {
   data <- data %>%
     mutate(
       window_start = (window_pos_1 %/% 500000) * 500000 + 1,
       window_end = window_start + 250000
     )
   return(data)  # Explicitly return the modified data
}

# Function to average pi to the windows 
average_pi <- function(data){
  data <-data %>% group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>% dplyr::summarise(avg_pi_window = sum((count_diffs)) / sum(count_comparisons))
  return(data)
}
```
## Calculate pi in sliding windows  
```{r}
pi_4fold_lyrata <- pi_4fold_lyrata %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
```
##Plot
```{r}
# Harmonize chrom naming
centromeres$chromosome <- centromeres$Chr
```

lyrata_plot <- ggplot(pi_lyrata, aes(x = window_start / 1e6, y = avg_pi_window)) +
